blocks.orig: Kenzan Migration Camp is located in the Ndutu region, in the northwestern part of the Ngorongoro Conservation Area. From December to March, it offers great opportunities to witness the calving season of the Great Migration, but also during the rest of the year it’s a great place for your (off-road) safari games drives. The 18 comfortable tents feature all necessary amenities, including an ensuite bathroom with a safari bucket shower to add a tad of adventure. In the evening, a tasty dinner is served in a large dining tent, and a campfire is lit so you can share your safari adventures with other guests under the starry sky. A good night’s sleep comes naturally, with the sounds of nature in the background!

Each of the 18 comfortable tents has everything you need, including an ensuite bathroom with a safari bucket shower for a little extra adventure.
